module_summary: Ethernet frame receiver: header/payload phase flags and a byte pointer capture the 14-byte MAC header into parallel output registers, then payload is forwarded through a lane-realign shifter and skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: read_eth_header_reg
anchors.why: Header-phase state flag enabling header byte capture

anchors.name: read_eth_payload_reg
anchors.why: Payload-phase state flag enabling payload forwarding

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header word pointer selecting which header field byte is captured

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame bytes, parsed into header fields or passed as payload

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid qualifying header capture and payload transfer

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready gated by output buffer and header handshake

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Header valid asserted after the 14th header byte

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clearing header valid and allowing input

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Captured destination MAC; representative of header field registers

anchors.name: m_eth_type_reg
anchors.why: Captured Ethertype field

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload stream data from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready driving skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: shift_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Realigned end-of-frame resetting pointer and flagging short header

anchors.name: shift_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Lane-realigned payload data (passthrough when OFFSET=0)

anchors.name: save_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Saved previous input word for lane realignment, unused at 8-bit width

anchors.name: shift_axis_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle flag for leftover realigned bytes

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Enables capture of input word into save registers

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears save state at frame end

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of output buffer gating extra-cycle transfers

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp word when output stalls

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable of output register from internal datapath

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy while receiving header or payload

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error when frame ends before complete header

groups.name: Header/payload controller
groups.description: Phase flags and pointer sequencing header capture then payload forwarding

groups.name: Header field registers
groups.description: Parallel destination/source MAC and Ethertype outputs with valid/ready

groups.name: Lane realign shifter
groups.description: Save register and shifter realigning payload after header (bypassed at 8-bit)
